provenance.method: product->industry production shares = sum over all regions of the supply matrix V[product, industry], normalised per product to sum to 1; shares < 0.0001 dropped and the remainder renormalised.
provenance.source: EXIOBASE 3 MRSUT (monetary multi-regional supply-use table), supply matrix
